subject: Consolidated invoicing & lockbox setup for renewal (PO 98765)
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena.park@summitedge.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@summitedge.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PO 98765 + consolidated invoicing for renewal

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for walking us through the renewal options yesterday. SummitEdge is ready to move forward on the 12-month capacity renewal (plus the +20% burst add-on we discussed). Attached is our PO (SummitEdge_PO_98765.pdf).

A few billing requests from our side to make processing easier for our AP team:
- Can Redwood consolidate invoices for the committed capacity onto a single monthly invoice for the master account (SummitEdge HQ)?
- We want payments routed to our lockbox account. I attached the lockbox instructions PDF.
- Please confirm the billing contact on file and whether you need an updated W-9 (I've attached SummitEdge_W9.pdf just in case).

Our AP lead (Cc'd) is Carlos — he handles payment setup and bank detail verification. If you need any additional company forms or an updated quote with the PO line included, let me know.

Next steps from our side: we can approve once we have a billing flow confirmed and the invoice includes the PO number.

Thanks,
Elena Park
Director of Finance
SummitEdge

Attachments: SummitEdge_PO_98765.pdf (application/pdf), SummitEdge_W9.pdf (application/pdf), SummitEdge_Lockbox_Instructions.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@summitedge.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO 98765 + consolidated invoicing for renewal

Hi Elena — thanks for sending over the PO and instructions.

Quick confirmations:
- We can include the PO number on all recurring invoices and consolidate the committed capacity lines onto a single monthly invoice for the master account.
- Lockbox routing is something our finance team will set up — I’m looping in Grace (Finance Ops) to validate the lockbox deposit details and confirm any changes to our remittance address.
- We have a copy of SummitEdge’s W-9 in the attachment list; if your AP needs Redwood's W-9 or an entity-specific payee, we can provide it.

Grace, Vivek — can you confirm the lockbox flow and whether you need any additional vendor information from SummitEdge (EIN, remit-to address, ACH details)? Also flag if there are any SSO/signing steps we need from legal for the invoice template change.

Elena — I'll follow up with a single-thread email once finance confirms so you have a clear checklist for your AP team.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>

Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO 98765 + consolidated invoicing for renewal

Marissa / Elena — I reviewed the attachments. A few notes from Finance Ops:

1) Remittance / lockbox
- We can accept lockbox deposit routing but need the bank lockbox account name, bank NACHA routing, and a PDF from your bank confirming the lockbox setup (SummitEdge_Lockbox_Instructions.pdf is a good start but we require bank confirmation).

2) Invoice layout and PO
- We will include the PO number on the invoice line and consolidate the committed capacity charges into one invoice. Please confirm whether the burst add-on should be billed on the same monthly invoice or as a separate usage line (SummitEdge prefers consolidated, but we need your confirmation).

3) Tax forms and Entity
- We have SummitEdge_W9.pdf attached; please confirm the legal entity name and EIN exactly as it should appear on the invoice to avoid tax/1099 mismatches.

4) Timing
- If we receive bank confirmation and EIN/legal name by next Tuesday (2027-06-15), finance can generate the first consolidated invoice with the PO number included for the July 1 billing cycle.

Vivek, flagging for any legal billing-term implications if SummitEdge requires a change to payment terms.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Director, Finance Operations
redwood.invoices@redwood.ai

Attachments referenced: SummitEdge_PO_98765.pdf, SummitEdge_W9.pdf, SummitEdge_Lockbox_Instructions.pdf

- Bank routing (NACHA): 121042882

- SummitEdge prefers consolidated billing (one monthly invoice with PO number; include burst usage as a single additional line item).

Let me know if you need anything else. We can aim for the July 1 invoice as long as the remittance lockbox is fully validated by your team.

Thanks,
